checks_form.title: Deploy frontend (scp+ssh)
checks_form.command: scp -i deploy/ssh_keys/app_server_key -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new frontend/dist.tgz root@mini.soulpulse.art:/tmp/dist.tgz && ssh -i deploy/ssh_keys/app_server_key -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new root@mini.soulpulse.art 'mkdir -p /var/www/soulpulse/frontend && tar -xzf /tmp/dist.tgz -C /var/www/soulpulse/frontend && chown -R www-data:www-data /var/www/soulpulse/frontend && nginx -t && systemctl reload nginx'
checks_form.last_result: scp: stat local "frontend/dist.tgz": No such file or directory
